purpose: Attempt to falsify the mechanism claim before the primary result is trusted. Controls execute as PART OF THE SAME authorized experiment, are NOT alternate strategies, and are NEVER promotable.

global_rules.gate_set_applied_to_controls: the IDENTICAL G1-G11 gate set and the identical estimator conventions (ARC02_STATISTICAL_GATES.json)
global_rules.control_evaluation_conventions: each control is evaluated on ITS OWN trade set with the SAME cost model (primary 10 bps), the SAME 0/10/20/40 bps scenarios and the SAME frozen seeds
global_rules.if_any_required_control_satisfies_ALL_cr: MECHANISM_NOT_IDENTIFIED => FINAL_STATUS = DISCOVERY_FAIL (terminal). No retuning of the primary based on control results is permitted.
global_rules.a_control_that_fails_at_least_one_critic: does NOT falsify the mechanism and does not affect the primary verdict

controls.name: reversed follower direction
controls.falsification_question: Is follower continuation load-bearing, or would trading the follower AGAINST the underreaction also appear to work (i.e. is the signal merely a mean-reversion artifact)?
controls.executable_definition: Take the PRIMARY signal set unchanged (same signal bars, same entry times, same exit times, same followers). Reverse ONLY the direction sign on the follower: a long-signal becomes SHORT and a short-signal becomes LONG. Same costs, same funding accounting, same gate set.
controls.expected_falsification: should fail; if the reversed direction satisfies all critical gates the continuation claim is not identified and the underreaction-to-continuation mechanism is refuted

controls.name: displaced entry (destroyed shock alignment)
controls.falsification_question: Is the edge specific to the immediate aftermath of the shock bar, or is it a slow drift the follower would deliver at any displaced entry?
controls.executable_definition: Take the PRIMARY signal set unchanged. Displace the entry by exactly +TIMING_CONTROL_OFFSET_BARS = +1 bar (+5 minutes) relative to the primary entry: entry_time_control = primary_entry_time_ms + 300000; exit_time_control = entry_time_control + 300000 (the same 1-bar hold). The rule, the signal bars, the thresholds and the follower are untouched; only the shock-to-holding-window alignment is destroyed.
controls.symmetric_negative_displacement: NOT ADMITTED: advancing the entry by -1 bar would place the entry at or before the decision instant and violate the PIT contract. The control is deliberately one-sided; this is a causal limitation, not a revisitable design choice.
controls.expected_falsification: should fail; if the displaced entry satisfies all critical gates the effect is not tied to the shock aftermath

controls.name: BTC leader information destroyed
controls.falsification_question: Does the contemporaneous BTC move carry the identifying information, or would any stale/misaligned BTC move plus the follower's own underreaction suffice?
controls.executable_definition: Replace the leader driver series by the SAME series displaced by exactly LEADER_CONTROL_LAG_BARS = 288 bars (24 hours): driver_return_control(t) = ln(close_btc(t - 288*BAR_MS) / close_btc(t - 289*BAR_MS)) and scale_control(t) = median(|driver returns at t - (288+j)*BAR_MS| for j = 1..288). The shock statistic, the threshold, the same-sign rule, the underreaction ratio, the follower, the entry/exit anchors, the holding length, the costs, the funding accounting and the gate set are ALL identical to the primary. The leader's CONTEMPORANEOUS information is destroyed; every read remains strictly past and every follower execution semantic is untouched. The substitution is fully deterministic (no randomness, no hash()).
changes: leader driver series displaced by 288 bars (24h)
controls.causality_note: the lagged reads are strictly older than the primary reads, so the control cannot read anything the primary could not
controls.expected_falsification: should fail; if the stale-leader variant satisfies all critical gates the BTC leader carries no identifying information and ARC-02 collapses into a follower-only continuation claim

controls.name: deterministic sign-flip null
controls.falsification_question: Would a purely mechanical sign artifact of this trade set satisfy the frozen gate set?
controls.executable_definition: Take the PRIMARY realized net trade returns at PRIMARY_COST_BPS in the frozen emission order. Using rng = random.Random(20260915), for each trade in order compute flipped_i = net_return_i * (+1 if rng.random() < 0.5 else -1). Evaluate the FULL critical gate set (including the bootstrap and permutation gates, which use their own frozen seeds) on the flipped series.
controls.no_python_hash: Python hash() is explicitly forbidden (process-salted, not reproducible)
changes: the sign of each realized net trade return
controls.expected_falsification: should fail; if the flipped series satisfies all critical gates the gate set is not discriminating and no ARC-02 result could be trusted

structural_control_evidence_available_be.scope: these checks prove the controls are executable, deterministic and causal. They contain NO economic information and do not execute any control economically.
